about:
I'm a full-stack engineer moving toward applied AI, currently finishing my MSc at EFREI Paris and preparing to apply to a graduate engineering program in South Korea.

At AXA, I work on Secure GPT, the company's internal LLM. Before that I built automated test infrastructure at JCDecaux for digital billboard systems running in 70+ countries, and shipped web features at Dassault Systèmes. I also spent three months as a research intern at NIT Akita College in Japan, training a computer-vision model to detect manufacturing defects on film capacitors. It was my first experience working in a lab environment.

On the side I build Reawon, an independent product ecosystem: Reafile, a browser-based AI file editor, and Polywon, an AI-powered language learning app.
